purpose: Wording rules for the Mae Sai replay. The replay is a historical reconstruction and a planning scenario, so its text must not claim real-time detection, a forecast, an official warning, a validation, return periods or a road schedule, and it must not rank the shelter sets or present a modelled hour as a safe time to leave. One file feeds both linters: apps/web/src/lib/replay-wording-lint.ts (vitest) and src/floodguard/wording_lint.py (pytest).
how_it_works: Text is normalised first: web addresses are removed, runs of white space become one space, curly apostrophes become straight ones and non-breaking hyphens become plain hyphens.
Each pattern in allow is then removed, in order. They are explicit negations such as 'not a forecast'. A new negation needs a new entry here; a plain 'not' somewhere in the sentence is not enough.
Whatever still matches a pattern in rules is a finding.

Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions that mean the same in JavaScript (flags iu) and in Python (re.IGNORECASE). Word edges are written as (?<![A-Za-z0-9_]) and (?![A-Za-z0-9_]) because \b treats Thai letters differently in the two engines.

rules.message: The replay is a historical reconstruction. Do not call it real-time.

Water levels update in realtime

bad: Live water level at the border bridge
ข้อมูลสดระดับน้ำแม่น้ำสาย

rules.message: The replay reconstructs a past event. It is not a forecast.

rules.pattern: (?<![A-Za-z0-9_])(?:validat|accura)[a-z]*|ความแม่นยำ|ความถูกต้อง
rules.message: Agreement with another data set is not validation or accuracy. Say 'agreement', 'size check' or 'plausibility'.

Validation against the season envelope
Model accuracy: 0.48

rules.pattern: (?<![A-Za-z0-9_])(?:precision|recall)(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|ค่าความระลึก|ค่าความเที่ยง
rules.message: Product 4009 is a season envelope, not a reference. Use 'share of modelled water inside the envelope' and 'share of the envelope reached by the model'.

Recall of the envelope: 0.704

rules.pattern: (?<![A-Za-z0-9_])September extent(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])GISTDA(?:'s)? map(?![A-Za-z0-9_])|ขอบเขตน้ำเดือนกันยายน|แผนที่ของ GISTDA
